## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

The new generic camera config flow autodetects image type for still images.  But it is not automatic for streams.  So if a camera only had a `stream_url` and no `still_image_url`, the content_type would be undefined.  This caused the thumbnail to fail for a stream #69128.

This PR fixes this by reinstating the `content_type` field, and defaulting to the user value if the autodetect is skipped.

It also enables the value to be read from YAML.

A small fix is made to the duplicate checking code which was triggering log errors.

issue_context.title: Still image not working for generic camera with no still image url
issue_context.body:
### The problem

A camera using the Generic Camera integration is not displaying a thumbnail. This camera has no still image URL configured, only using the stream source URL. Clicking on the camera to view the stream works fine, only the thumbnail is not working. An error is logged every time a dashboard with this camera is viewed. 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/952387/161382198-6513b433-d234-4ab1-8f78-155fcff7545d.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/952387/161382188-e587fe91-31e0-4594-a940-d3910eee6a71.png)


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.0b3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.3.8

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

generic camera

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://rc.home-assistant.io/integrations/generic/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
In case it helps, here's the old yaml config I was using prior to this month's betas:
camera:
    - platform: generic
      stream_source: rtsp://redacted:redacted@192.168.redacted/live
      name: "Driveway Cam"
      verify_ssl: false
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

comments:
Hey there @davet2001, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`generic`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L365) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Thanks for reporting this!
It looks like the content type is not getting assigned to a valid value in this case.

This should happen automatically but obviously it isn't.  I will look at it in more detail 5/4/2022 pm, as I'm currently without computer access.

Ok, I have reproduced this.

The problem is: 

- Content type is now worked out automatically for still images.
- It is not worked out automatically for stream based images.
- If there is no stream image, the content type is set to None.

I also noticed that if the content type is defined in the YAML, it is ignored.

This causes the _async_get_image() to fail when called to get the still image preview for a stream because it does not know the content_type.

I think the fix will be:

1. Reinstate the 'content_type' field during the config flow.
2. Correctly use the YAML 'content_type' field when importing.

> Still broken in 2022.04 (stable)

The fix #69378 has not been merged yet and is currently planned for 2022.4.1

Please also update the documentation page to include information about the content type. Since the auto detection isn't working, I had to go digging through old documentation commits on github to figure out how to set the content type.
@iridris What content type did you set? I am using wyze cams with Wyze Docker, not on RTSP if this helps.

> @iridris What content type did you set? I am using wyze cams with Wyze Docker, not on RTSP if this helps.

@dnestico I used `video/mpeg` which seems to work perfectly!
Still fails in 2022.4.5. Is that expected?

> Still fails in 2022.4.5. Is that expected? 

Please try deleting your camera from the UI and restarting HA to trigger re-import from YAML.

I've already removed integration from config file.
Re-adding integration from UI worked, thank you. But adding entities named from full rtsp url including password looks extremely weird. I've renamed both, but..
@dmnfortytwo I agree that is a bit strange.  Could you create an issue ticket for that? Should be a simple fix as there is a redact function used elsewhere.

review_comments: Why is content type necessary? I don't see it in the YAML config? https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/generic

It used to be in the docs but I removed it for 2022.4 because I thought it could be determined automatically.
https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/pull/14841/files

Now having to add it back in because of #69128.  Evidently the camera object complains if it doesn't have a content_type, and it can't be determined automatically if only a stream is specified.

> and it can't be determined automatically if only a stream is specified.

Rather that has not been implemented (yet).  But I intend to.
Between step 1 and 2 we can try to determine the content type. If we can't determine, ask the user for content type.
Yes, this is how it is now implemented.
